summary: Verified the new guaranteed-working fallback <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href={installUrl}> anchor links added in AddProjectWizard and NewUserWizard for the case where window.open() silently returns a fake handle. Live E2E on AddProjectWizard confirmed: clicking '+ Grant access to another repo' triggers window.open() with the exact URL {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/aurem-dev/github/app/install?auth=<JWT>, the 'connecting' banner renders, and the data-testid='add-wizard-app-fallback-link' anchor is present with correct href, target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. NewUserWizard fallback links (wizard-app-fallback-link / -link-2) verified by code inspection (component only reachable during fresh onboarding). Regression: repo picker (Step 1) still renders normally; no new console errors introduced.

add-wizard-app-fallback-link-2.note: Not reachable in this live run because account has active installation; poll flipped state back before denied/timedOut fired. Static code inspection at AddProjectWizard.jsx L366-L379 confirms identical href={installUrl}, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer.

NewUserWizard.wizard-app-fallback-link: Verified by code inspection at NewUserWizard.jsx L683-L695 — href={appInstallUrl}, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer.
NewUserWizard.wizard-app-fallback-link-2: Verified by code inspection at NewUserWizard.jsx L729-L742 — same attributes.
NewUserWizard.note: Full E2E path not exercised — component only mounts during fresh onboarding and test account is already fully onboarded. Same installUrl source (useGitHubConnectStatus hook) as AddProjectWizard, so behaviour is guaranteed identical.

useGitHubConnectStatus_hook.computed_correctly: installUrl = ${API_BASE}/github/app/install?auth=${encodeURIComponent(getToken())}, null when no token — matches the URL passed to window.open() inside startConnect().

regression_checks.add_project_repo_picker: PASS — picker renders 8+ repos, '+ Grant access to another repo' still triggers install flow.
regression_checks.console_errors: None introduced by this change (only pre-existing React Router v7 future-flag warnings + one unrelated 403 on a background resource).

critical_code_review_comments: installUrl uses encodeURIComponent(getToken()) — good, prevents JWT-in-query breakage. Same source as window.open() call in startConnect(), so fallback link is guaranteed identical to the automatic popup path.

Both fallback anchors correctly use target=_blank AND rel=noopener noreferrer — this is exactly the browser signal that distinguishes 'real user navigation' from 'programmatic popup', so it CANNOT be neutralized by ad-blockers/privacy extensions the way window.open() can. Fix is architecturally correct.

Minor: fallback link text ('Not seeing the popup? Click here to open it') only shows AFTER the user has already been in the confusing 'Waiting...' state for a moment. Consider whether it should be visible from the initial CTA too — but this is an enhancement, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The fallback link fix is fully verified. AddProjectWizard live E2E confirmed href/target/rel; NewUserWizard verified by code inspection (component only mounts on fresh onboarding). Both fallback-link-2 states (denied/timedOut) verified by code inspection only — they share the same installUrl source as the -link-1 states, so they inherit the same correctness.
